summary:
Iteration 13 — validated 4 new features (Safe Link Checker, Nearby Police, Community Group, live WhatsApp alerts stack) + regression. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS (test_safety_community.py):

(A) Safe Link Checker: POST /api/safety/link-check with VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY unset returns HTTP 200 {configured:false, message:'…not configured yet.'} — graceful no-crash. Auth required (401 without token). Input validation rejects url shorter than 4 chars (422).

(B) Nearby Police Stations: GET /api/safety/nearby-police?lat=28.6139&lng=77.2090&radius=8000 returned {count:>0, stations:[…]} with name/lat/lng/distance_km on each station and array sorted ascending by distance_km. Remote ocean coords (0,0) returned {count:0, stations:[]} gracefully. Backend uses 3 Overpass mirrors with User-Agent — first hit succeeded via maps.mail.ru mirror.

(C) Community Safety Group: full flow ok — GET /api/community returns {member_count, cap:100, is_member, posts}; POST /join is idempotent; POST /posts requires membership (non-member => 403 'Join the group to post.'); POST /posts/{id}/like toggles like_count 0↔1 and liked_by_me correctly (uses symmetric_difference set semantics); DELETE /posts/{id} by non-owner => 403; owner can delete. Photo size cap (2.5MB) enforced via 400.

(D) Regression: POST /me/sos 200; /me/emergency-contacts GET/POST/PUT/DELETE full CRUD 200; POST /me/live-share 200 (token issued); POST /me/location + GET /public/live/{token} 200; POST /auth/otp/request returns {channel, live} (live may be false in preview).

Frontend Playwright (desktop 1400x1000, Delhi geolocation granted): login demo_web@safeqr.com→/dashboard PASS. /safety page renders all 7 panels (sos-panel, siren-panel, contacts-panel, live-share-panel, helplines-panel, link-checker-panel, police-panel). Link checker: submitting https://example.com triggers link-checker-unconfigured message correctly. Nearby police: Find-near-me hit the API but the second UI call to Overpass returned zero stations (rate-limited by mirrors during test window) — police-error rendered. Same endpoint returns real stations in the pytest run seconds earlier, so this is Overpass mirror rate-limit flakiness, NOT a code bug (backend already tries 3 mirrors). /community page: member-count badge shows 3/100 after joining, composer visible, posting → like → delete own-post flow all worked end-to-end via data-testid selectors community-text-input / community-post-btn / community-like-<id> / community-delete-<id>.

minor.issue: Overpass mirrors are shared community endpoints and can rate-limit rapid successive calls. Backend correctly falls through 3 mirrors and returns 502 only when all fail. Consider caching by rounded (lat,lng,radius) for ~30 min to smooth out mirror hiccups and reduce user-facing 'Could not find nearby police stations.'

integration_issues.issue: During Playwright run the UI showed 'Could not find nearby police stations.' — root cause is Overpass mirror rate-limit (env flakiness, not code). Backend test hit the same endpoint successfully seconds earlier.

action_items: (Optional) Cache /api/safety/nearby-police responses by rounded coords (e.g. 3-decimal) for ~30 min to hide Overpass mirror rate-limits from users.

(Optional) Consider server-side 'no key' response for /safety/link-check also including a docs link / where-to-set-key hint so ops know how to enable it — currently only surfaces the sentence 'Safe Link Checker is not configured yet.' — good enough.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1214: link-check early-returns {configured:false} BEFORE consuming the request body/rate-limit properly — that is fine, but the @rate_limit('10/minute') still applies which is good.

server.py L1382-1390 community_like uses symmetric_difference_update on a Python set with a single-element set — semantically equivalent to toggle and correct, but a simple `if uid in likes: likes.remove(uid) else likes.append(uid)` on a list would be more readable and avoid the set→list roundtrip.
server.py L1394-1401 community_delete correctly enforces (own OR admin). Good.

server.py L1298-1312 nearby_police iterates elements and computes _haversine_km — good. Consider using Overpass 'out center;' output_size guard (currently 40) and adding basic in-memory or Mongo cache by (round(lat,3), round(lng,3), radius) with 30-min TTL to reduce Overpass load.
server.py is now 5074 lines — split into routers (safety, community, auth, admin, org, dealer) has become urgent for maintainability.

Safety.jsx LinkChecker (line 239) — after submit, existing `res` from a previous verdict is not cleared when a new 'configured:false' response comes back, so old result card may linger visually; small polish item.

Safety.jsx NearbyPolice — error state 'Could not find nearby police stations.' is not distinguishable from '0 results': the police-empty state only shows when the map has rendered. Consider retry-button when 502 comes back.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical selectors + flows pass; nearby-police UI intermittently blocked by Overpass rate-limit — env)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_c_<hex>@safeqr.com second user created for community 403 tests; test posts created and DELETED within the same test (owner cleanup). No orphan data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints added this iter: POST /api/safety/link-check (returns {configured:false} while VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY unset — do NOT flag as bug); GET /api/safety/nearby-police (uses Overpass, occasionally 502/empty due to mirror rate-limits — retry once before failing); /api/community (member cap 100), /api/community/join, /api/community/leave, /api/community/posts (POST list requires membership → 403), /api/community/posts/{id}/like (toggle), DELETE /api/community/posts/{id} (owner-or-admin). UI selectors: link-checker-panel/input/btn/unconfigured, police-panel/find-btn/map/row/empty/error, community-page/count/join-btn/leave-btn/composer/text-input/post-btn/photo-label/photo-input/like-<id>/delete-<id>. Regression endpoints unchanged. Existing test files still valid: test_msg91_migration.py, test_web_flows.py, test_car_qr_incidents.py, test_dealer_and_masked_call.py, test_org_and_tag_edit.py, test_tags_guardian.py, test_bulk_tag_and_persona.py.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only UI failure observed (nearby-police error) reproduces only under back-to-back rapid calls to the shared Overpass mirrors (rate-limit / temporary 429/timeout). Mitigation: add short-TTL cache keyed by rounded coordinates in nearby_police, and surface a Retry button in NearbyPolice.jsx when the backend returns 502.
